questions.question: Container nima va virtual mashinadan tubdan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
questions.explanation: Container — umumiy host kernel'da ishlaydigan izolyatsiyalangan Linux process; izolyatsiya namespace'lar, resurs cheklash cgroup'lar bilan. VM esa hypervisor ustida to'liq guest OS ishlatadi — alohida virtual hardware...

questions.question: Container izolyatsiyasini ta'minlovchi Linux namespace'larini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: PID: process daraxti (container o'z asosiy process'ini PID 1 deb ko'radi).

questions.question: cgroups nima va v1 bilan v2 farqi?
questions.explanation: cgroups process guruhlari uchun resurs (CPU, xotira, disk I/O, PID) taqsimoti va limitlarini majburlaydi.

questions.question: Container runtime ierarxiyasi (high-level va low-level) qanday?
questions.explanation: High-level (CRI runtime): lifecycle, image pull, unpack, tarmoq sozlash (containerd, CRI-O).

questions.question: OCI (Open Container Initiative) qaysi spetsifikatsiyalarni belgilaydi?
questions.explanation: Linux Foundation loyihasi:

questions.question: `runc` nima?
questions.explanation: OCI runtime spec'ning reference implementatsiyasi: Go'da yozilgan yengil CLI; namespace va cgroup'larni sozlab container process'ini ishga tushiradi va o'zi chiqib ketadi.

questions.question: `containerd` va `containerd-shim` nima?
questions.explanation: containerd — image transfer, storage va execution'ni boshqaradigan sanoat standarti runtime. containerd-shim — containerd va runc orasidagi yengil daemon: stdin/stdout/stderr va exit code'ni ushlab turadi, shuning uch...

questions.question: CRI-O nima?
questions.explanation: Faqat Kubernetes uchun yaratilgan yengil CRI runtime — OCI container'larni Docker'siz bevosita ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Sandboxed runtime'lar (gVisor, Kata Containers) nima?
questions.explanation: gVisor (runsc): userspace'da ishlaydigan Go'da yozilgan "application kernel" — syscall'larni ushlab o'zi bajaradi, container va host kernel orasida kuchli chegara.

questions.question: Overlay fayl tizimi (overlay2) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta papka qatlamini bitta ko'rinishga birlashtiruvchi union mount:

questions.question: Docker'da Copy-on-Write (CoW) nima?
questions.explanation: Read-only image layer'laridagi fayllar barcha container'lar orasida bo'lishiladi. Container faylni o'zgartirmoqchi bo'lsa, storage driver uni avval yuqori read-write qatlamga nusxalaydi (copy-up) — disk va xotira teja...

questions.question: Multi-stage Dockerfile nima va nega production uchun muhim?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta FROM li Dockerfile: birinchi stage'da compiler, SDK, build tool'lar; keyingisiga faqat tayyor binary minimal runtime image'ga (distroless, alpine) nusxalanadi — image 1GB dan o'nlab MB ga tushadi va build t...

questions.question: Distroless image'lar nima?
questions.explanation: Faqat ilova binary'si va uning runtime dependency'larini o'z ichiga olgan base image'lar: package manager yo'q, shell (/bin/sh) yo'q, OS utilitalari yo'q — hujum yuzasi va CVE soni keskin kamayadi (debug uchun ephemer...

questions.question: Dockerfile'da `CMD` va `ENTRYPOINT` farqi.
questions.explanation: ENTRYPOINT: container start'da doim ishlaydigan asosiy executable.

questions.question: `CMD ["node", "server.js"]` (exec form) va `CMD node server.js` (shell form) farqi.
questions.explanation: Exec form (JSON array): binary bevosita PID 1 bo'ladi va SIGTERM/SIGINT ni to'g'ri oladi — graceful shutdown.

questions.question: Rootless Docker / Rootless Podman nima?
questions.explanation: Daemon va container process'larini host root huquqisiz, imtiyozsiz user namespace'da ishlatish. Container breakout bo'lsa ham hujumchi host'da faqat oddiy foydalanuvchi huquqini oladi.

questions.question: Docker capabilities (`CAP_SYS_ADMIN`, `CAP_NET_ADMIN`) nima?
questions.explanation: Root huquqining mayda bo'laklari. Docker default'da xavfli capability'larni olib tashlaydi; yaxshi amaliyot — hammasini olib tashlash (--cap-drop=ALL) va faqat keraklisini qo'shish (--cap-add=NET_BIND_SERVICE). CAP_SY...

questions.question: Nega `--privileged` bilan container ishlatish xavfli?
questions.explanation: Barcha host qurilmalariga kirish, AppArmor/SELinux profillarini o'chirish, barcha capability'lar — container'dan qochish (escape) juda oson bo'lib qoladi.

questions.question: Container'da zombie (defunct) process nima?
questions.explanation: Bajarilishi tugagan, lekin parent wait() bilan exit status'ini o'qimagani uchun process jadvalida qolgan child. Container'dagi PID 1 yetim process'larni "reap" qilmasa zombie'lar to'planib PID limitini tugatadi.

questions.question: `tini` / `dumb-init` nima?
questions.explanation: Container'da PID 1 bo'lib ishlaydigan yengil init: signal'larni (SIGTERM) child'larga uzatadi va zombie'larni reap qiladi (docker run --init).

questions.question: Docker BuildKit nima?
questions.explanation: Zamonaviy build engine: stage'larni parallel build, remote cache import/export, secret'ni layer'ga yozmasdan mount qilish (RUN --mount=type=secret), SSH forwarding.

questions.question: Multi-arch build (`docker buildx`) nima?
questions.explanation: QEMU emulyatsiyasi (binfmt_misc) yoki native builder'lar bilan bir nechta arxitektura (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) uchun image yasab, bitta multi-arch manifest list'ga jamlash.

questions.question: OCI image manifest va manifest list nima?
questions.explanation: Manifest: image'ni tashkil qiluvchi config hash, media type va layer digest'larini ko'rsatuvchi JSON.

questions.question: Docker bridge, host va none tarmoq rejimlari farqi.
questions.explanation: Bridge (default): host'da virtual bridge (docker0); container'lar private IP oladi, tashqariga NAT/port mapping orqali.

questions.question: Docker Swarm va Kubernetes farqi.
questions.explanation: Swarm — Docker'ning nativ klasterlash vositasi: sozlash oson, lekin routing, autoscaling va ekotizim cheklangan. Kubernetes — sanoat standarti: deklarativ reconcile, service discovery, autoscaling, murakkab storage va...

questions.question: Container healthcheck (`HEALTHCHECK`) nima?
questions.explanation: Dockerfile instruktsiyasi: container engine muntazam bajaradigan buyruq (curl -f http://localhost:8080/healthz || exit 1) — ilova sog'lommi aniqlash uchun. Kubernetes bu instruktsiyani e'tiborsiz qoldiradi va o'z prob...

questions.question: Docker volume, bind mount va tmpfs farqi.
questions.explanation: Volume: Docker boshqaradi (/var/lib/docker/volumes/), host fayl tizimidan ajratilgan.

questions.question: Docker Compose nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p container'li ilovalarni deklarativ YAML (compose.yaml) bilan e'lon qilib ishga tushirish vositasi.

questions.question: Kaniko nima (container kontekstida)?
questions.explanation: Google'ning ochiq tool'i: Dockerfile'dan image'ni Kubernetes pod ichida Docker daemon va privileged root'siz build qiladi.

questions.question: Buildah, Podman va Skopeo farqi.
questions.explanation: Buildah: daemon'siz OCI image build.

questions.question: Docker build'ga secret'ni image tarixida ko'rinmaydigan qilib qanday uzatasiz?
questions.explanation: BuildKit secret mount: RUN --mount=type=secret,id=mysecret cat /run/secrets/mysecret (build: --secret id=mysecret,src=...). Secret build paytida xotiraga mount qilinadi va hech qaysi layer'da saqlanmaydi. ARG/ENV bila...

questions.question: Docker'da layer caching qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Har instruktsiya natijasi cache'lanadi; instruktsiya va undan oldingilari o'zgarmasa, cache qayta ishlatiladi. Tez o'zgaradiganlar (COPY . .) pastda, sekin o'zgaradiganlar (dependency o'rnatish) yuqorida bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: `.dockerignore` nima va nega muhim?
questions.explanation: Build context'ga yuborilmaydigan fayllar ro'yxati (node_modules, .git, .env, log'lar) — build tezlashadi va secret'lar image'ga tushib qolmaydi.

questions.question: CSI (Container Storage Interface) nima?
questions.explanation: Storage provayderlariga (EBS, Ceph, NetApp) Kubernetes yadro kodini o'zgartirmasdan block/file storage plugin yozish imkonini beradigan standart interfeys.

questions.question: CNI (Container Network Interface) nima?
questions.explanation: Container va pod'lar uchun tarmoq interfeysi, IP va routing'ni sozlashning standart interfeysi (Calico, Cilium, AWS VPC CNI).

questions.question: CRI (Container Runtime Interface) nima?
questions.explanation: kubelet turli runtime'lar (containerd, CRI-O) bilan gRPC orqali gaplashadigan API — Kubernetes'ni qayta compile qilmasdan.

questions.question: Distroless va Alpine base image farqi.
questions.explanation: Alpine musl libc va apk ishlatadi (Python/Node C-extension'larda nozik bug va DNS farqlari bo'lishi mumkin). Distroless Debian'ning glibc sini ishlatadi, shell va package manager yo'q — yaxshiroq moslik va kichik huju...

questions.question: Podman Quadlet nima?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ container fayllarini nativ systemd service unit'larga aylantiradigan generator — container'larni oddiy Linux servisi sifatida boshqarish.

questions.question: Docker context nima?
questions.explanation: Docker CLI'ning target engine'ini almashtirish mexanizmi (lokal daemon, SSH orqali masofaviy server).

questions.question: Docker Content Trust (DCT) qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Notary orqali raqamli imzolar bilan registry'dan olinayotgan image publisher'i va yaxlitligini tekshiradi (DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1).

questions.question: OCI artifact nima?
questions.explanation: Container bo'lmagan fayllar (Helm chart, WebAssembly, OPA policy, SBOM) OCI spetsifikatsiyasi bilan standart registry'da saqlanadi.

questions.question: Docker Scout / Trivy nima?
questions.explanation: Image layer'larini tahlil qilib OS paketlari va til dependency'laridagi CVE'larni topadigan va tuzatish taklif qiladigan tool'lar.

questions.question: OCI'da `config.json` nima?
questions.explanation: runc o'qiydigan deklarativ spetsifikatsiya: namespace, mount, capability, process argumentlari va resurs limitlari.

questions.question: Flatpak, Snap va Docker container farqi.
questions.explanation: Flatpak va Snap — desktop ilovalarni sandbox'da tarqatish formatlari; Docker — server process'lari va mikroservislar uchun optimallashgan, OCI standartiga ega.

questions.question: Container'da fork bomb nima va qanday oldi olinadi?
questions.explanation: Cheksiz child process yaratib kernel PID jadvalini tugatuvchi zararli process. cgroup PID limiti bilan (--pids-limit 100, Kubernetes podPidsLimit).

questions.question: Container'da memory swappiness nima?
questions.explanation: memory-swappiness — xotira bosimida kernel container anonymous sahifalarini diskka qanchalik agressiv swap qilishini boshqaradi.

questions.question: OOMKilled (exit code 137) nima?
questions.explanation: Container xotirasi cgroup limitidan (limits.memory) oshganda kernel OOM killer process'ni o'ldiradi (SIGKILL = 128+9).

questions.question: CPU CFS throttling nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel CPU limitini davr (odatda 100ms) bo'yicha majburlaydi. Container kvotasini dastlabki 20ms da tugatsa, qolgan 80ms "muzlatiladi" — latency'da keskin sakrashlar. Shu sabab latency'ga sezgir servislarda CPU limit ...

questions.question: `seccomp` nima?
questions.explanation: Container process'i kernel'ga qaysi syscall'larni chaqira olishini filtrlaydigan kernel mexanizmi — xavfli syscall'lar (reboot, ptrace) bloklanadi (RuntimeDefault profil).

questions.question: Container'lar uchun AppArmor / SELinux nima?
questions.explanation: Mandatory Access Control kernel modullari: foydalanuvchi huquqidan qat'i nazar container'larga nozik fayl va process ruxsat profillarini majburlaydi.

questions.question: `docker system prune` nima?
questions.explanation: Ishlatilmayotgan Docker ma'lumotlarini tozalaydi: to'xtagan container'lar, dangling image'lar, build cache, tarmoqlar (-a --volumes bilan ko'proq — ehtiyot bo'ling).

questions.question: Docker plugin nima?
questions.explanation: Daemon'ga imkoniyat qo'shuvchi tashqi process: custom network, volume yoki logging driver'lar.

questions.question: Docker'da `iptables` roli qanday?
questions.explanation: Docker fizik interfeyslar va docker0 bridge orasida paketlarni yo'naltirish va NAT (port publish) uchun iptables qoidalarini sozlaydi. Eslatma: Docker qoidalari UFW'ni chetlab o'tishi mumkin.

questions.question: Docker daemon (`dockerd`) nima?
questions.explanation: Image, container, tarmoq va volume'larni boshqaradigan va Docker REST API so'rovlarini tinglaydigan fon process.

questions.question: Image digest nima?
questions.explanation: Image manifest'ining o'zgarmas SHA256 hash'i (image@sha256:abcd...) — tag o'zgarsa ham aynan bir xil image bit'larini kafolatlaydi. Prod'da digest bilan pin qiling.

questions.question: Dockerfile'da layer invalidation nima?
questions.explanation: Instruktsiya o'zgarsa, uning va undan keyingi barcha instruktsiyalarning cache'i bekor bo'ladi va noldan bajariladi.

questions.question: Docker socket (`/var/run/docker.sock`) nima va nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: Docker CLI daemon bilan gaplashadigan UNIX socket. Uni container'ga mount qilish container'ga host ustidan to'liq root nazoratini beradi.

questions.question: Container attestation nima?
questions.explanation: Image'ga biriktirilgan, build provenance, test natijalari va zaiflik skani mosligini tasdiqlovchi kriptografik imzolangan bayonotlar.

questions.question: `cri-dockerd` nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes dockershim ni olib tashlagandan keyin Docker Engine'ni CRI runtime sifatida ishlatishda davom etish uchun adapter.

questions.question: Firecracker microVM nima?
questions.explanation: AWS'ning ochiq virtualizatsiya texnologiyasi: ~125ms ichida kam xotirali xavfsiz microVM yaratadi; Lambda va Fargate asosida.
